dylan: Running a Launchpad signal experiment next week. Plan: 150-seat funnel test to evaluate two credit deliveries (one-shot vs drip) and two onboarding templates. Primary: week-1 activation lift. Secondary: CPL and time-to-first-success. Quick input? :compass:

maya: Solid. Suggest 150 randomized, split even. Credits: One-shot=80 now, Drip=30 now + 25 after 48h + 25 on engagement. Templates: Pack (curated starter templates) vs Builder (editable examples).

zoe: Webinar ops: 4 regional office hours during week 1. Landing page live Mon, reminders: confirm, 48h, 1h. Post-webinar email includes credit top-up for engaged users.

nate: Creative: hero + 20s demo + social cuts. Messaging: "Build a useful result in minutes" with a tiny benchmark card: time-to-first-success median. Assets by Tue EOD.

leah: Dashboard needs: day1/day7 activation, CPL, time-to-success histogram, credit-burn curve, A/B by arm. I'll mock Console widgets and share link. Also writing short email sequences for both arms.

aj: Routing: utm=launchpad_signal. Tag users by arm and credit model. If user >3 requests in 24h mark as engaged and invite to office hours. Instrument events for attribution.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Autoscale policy updated for project/launchpad-signal (min=1,max=20). Alerts: p95 latency > 600ms -> page oncall.

dylan: Infra ask: pre-warm 25m before each office hour, prefix caching for starter prompts, fallback to quantized variant at 80% util. @aj and @leah we need analytics hooks for credit burn by hour.

maya: Timeline recap: soft-launch Mon internal (staff + partners), public Tue, first office hour Wed. Action items: @aj tags/events, @leah dashboard + emails, @nate assets, @ops-bot infra pre-warm + fallback. Quick sync Fri 10:00 to confirm readiness. Thanks! :rocket:
